title: HelioStack: Open-Source Solar PV, 3D Shading, OpenFOAM CFD & LiFePO4 ESS Optimization Workbench
description:
HelioStack (pip install heliostack, AGPL-3.0-or-later) is a deterministic open-source solar PV, 3D ray-cast shading, OpenFOAM CFD thermal, and HiGHS LiFePO4 energy-storage optimization workbench with 0% generative AI at runtime and byte-deterministic RO-Crate 1.1 + SHA-256 audit provenance.

  • OpenFOAM 14 28° Tilted PV Thermal Sweep: Reproducible steady RANS (foamRun -solver fluid, kOmegaSST, 5,910 cells, 8 cases) comparing land open-rack vs. pontoon Floating-PV cooling and convective heat transfer.
  • Copernicus DEM & pvlib ModelChain Parity: 36-azimuth ray-cast alpine horizon extraction (Innsbruck, Bolzano, Zermatt; MAE 1.25–1.57° vs. EU PVGIS printhorizon) and canonical pvlib ModelChain parity (−0.67% Amsterdam, +0.31% Seville).
  • Dual-Continent Field Validation: University of Cyprus PHAETHON CoE 1-year outdoor testbed (8,784 hours, Tmod RMSE 2.18 °C, DC R² = 0.9887) and US DOE/NREL PVDAQ #2107 892.8 kWp utility telemetry (3,255 daylight hours, R² = 0.9101, MBE = +3.81%, nRMSE = 6.79%).
  • Offline Browser Workbench: Zero-telemetry interactive simulator covering 100 kWp research/commercial baselines, 0.8 kWp citizen balcony solar (Balkonkraftwerk), and 6 kWp rooftop/community microgrids at https://ttthkim-hue.github.io/heliostack/.
